author: Diabolicx
body:
Application

Age: 15

Timezone: GMT+4

Do you have access to TeamSpeak? Yes

Do you have access to Skype? Yes

Do you have access to a recording software? Yes





CRITERIA 1: SELF REFLECTION/EVALUATION


Do you have any experience as a staff member on any servers?

I was a referee and translator on Overcast and currently am a referee and transator on Avicus (except that I haven’t reffed any matches on Avicus), I was a moderator on a few small discord servers, and was a moderator on a small Minecraft server that shut down last year.


What is your biggest weakness and how do you believe it will affect your moderating? What is your biggest strength and how would this affect your moderating?

My biggest weakness is probably me being too nice. If I come across a player breaking the rules (not hacking), instead of directly giving him a kick/ban I would first start by sending him a message warning him, then actually warn him, then a kick and then a ban, whereas other mods would directly kick/ban. My biggest strength is probably my ability to quickly learn things, understand them fairly easily and teach people what I learned. This will definitely affect my moderating, as I would quickly learn the rules and guidelines, and possibly help out other juniors in my batch that are struggling.


How do you believe you can help improve the Staff Team?

I would probably try to improve the quality of the moderation department in general. Listening to the community is a key part in this process, so I would be checking the forums/slack a lot, I would make a few polls on the forums and try to get more ideas from other staff members. There are currently two issues I would like to fix: staff activity and staff's behavior. Staff activity doesn't really need explaining, if a moderator isn't on a leave of absence then he/she should be demoted after a few weeks. Staff behavior is an issue I saw on multiple servers: the player would tryhard until he/she gets the rank he desires, then simply stop doing any work. A moderator who is active but doesn't do any moderator work is like an inactive moderator: useless. I would make sure that the staff members are doing the work they're supposed to do correctly. I could also work on having more transparency between the staff team and the community. Updates shouldn't be a surprise to the community, and the staff team should always take the community's opinion into consideration when working on an update.


What qualities does a leader need to have in your opinion? Do you consider yourself to be a leader? Why?

Unlike a boss, a leader is someone, who instead of ordering people, teaches them and helps them improve, all while improving himself at the same time. A leader needs to be knowledgeable, patient and must be easily understandable. I consider to be myself a leader, but not in all fields. For example, at school, I am really good in Arabic and often find myself helping friends out with their Arabic homework. They consider me a leader in that class. Other than that, I am patient and easily understandable, but my knowledge is limited in some subjects, but I try to expand it whenever I can.


What attributes distinguish yourself from other players that qualify you to be a moderator?

I am mature, patient, active, a quick learner, serious and dedicated. These attributes distinguish me from other players and I believe that they qualify me to be a moderator. I'm easily approachable and easy to talk to. I also have a clean record on Avicus, and have no infractions to brag about. I will take the role seriously and won't break any rules.


What skills do you believe you should have when interacting with the community? Do you believe you have these skills?

When interacting with the community, patience and the ability to listen are skills that any staff member should have, and I believe that I have these skills. Staff members not listening to the community is an issue I witnessed on many servers and would not like to see on Avicus. Patience is for the few irritating people you will come across, and dealing with them in a calm and professional way is better than getting angry at them.


How much time can you commit to being a staff member (Rough Idea)?

On the forums, I can be on every day at any time (except when I’m asleep), and in game I can be on for sure on Thursdays, Fridays and Saturdays, but maybe not during the rest of the week (depending on the amount of homework I have).





CRITERIA 2: GENERAL SITUATIONS

You are currently undergoing your junior moderator trial. A ban evader is online and he is constantly ban evading and hacking. You are the only one online and the only one who is able to be online. What would you do?

Considering that I am still a junior and that I still have things to learn, I would ask for help on the staff discord, and while waiting I would simply ban the alts he is using to connect to the server. After a while the hacker would get bored or run out of unbanned alts, and the problem would be solved. If a senior staff does come on to help, then he would ban the player's IP and the problem would also be solved.


Another staff member is constantly joining and harassing other people on Teamspeak in their team channel. The staff member is also referee and has physical permissions to be in that channel. However the leaders do not want this staff member in there and they have asked him to leave multiple times. What would you do?

(I wrote this answer based on the assumption that the staff member in question is only a referee). The team members and leaders are probably mad, so I would join the team channel (I can do that because I am a referee) and try to calm the situation down by talking to the leaders and muting the referee. I would then try to reason with the staff member, talk to him and try to convince him to stop. Then, I'd talk to the officials and tell them that the staff member is abusing his perms as a referee and describe what happened to them.


A player appeals a punishment you gave them. You realize that the evidence file is corrupted and therefore there is no physical evidence. You know however this person did indeed break the rules, what would you do?

I have no choice but to appeal their punishment, and watch them in game. If they don’t break any rules then that would be great, but if they do end up breaking rules I’ll record/screenshot evidence and pay attention to the evidence files so that they won’t get corrupted again.


You are in an Avicus team. One of your teammates is also an Avicus Staff member. One day in your team discord the team member/staff member posts a screenshot of a thread that only staff members can see. The content in the screenshot isn’t very important/confident but only staff members could see it on the forums. If anything, what would you do?

I would report that staff member to the senior staff, and they would take action. The information on the screenshot isn’t very important, so making him delete his message on discord wouldn’t be too necessary, but I would still try to.


One day the Senior Staff team makes a decision you do not agree with. You do not know all the details of the decision or the circumstances in which they were made and you were simply told by another staff member. However you do not like the decision based from what you know. What would you do?

I would talk to the senior staff about this decision to learn more about its details and its circumstances. If I still disagree with it, I would try to explain why and hopefully propose more efficient alternatives to the decision. If the senior staff disagree with me, then I have no choice but to deal with the decision without complaining about it.





CRITERIA 3: OTHER

What would getting moderator on Avicus mean to you?

Getting moderator would make me feel like I have actually achieved something, and that feeling is nice. I am aware that moderating is completely voluntary and I am willing to sacrifice some of my time to do it, for personal satisfaction.


How passionate are you about Avicus? What does Avicus mean to you?

Avicus is currently the only reason I still play Minecraft. Even though I started becoming active quite recently, Avicus does mean a lot to me and I would like to see it grow and improve. I can assure you that I won’t be one of those mods that go inactive or that stop doing work after their promotion.


Do you speak any other languages than English?

I speak Arabic and French.


Do you have anything else to add to your application?

I do not. Thank you for reading.



- Diabolicx

[Denied] - I am sorry to say your application has been denied. for the following reasons:

- Poor behaviour towards others

- General interaction. We'd like if you got a bit more involved with Avicus first

You may not submit another application. Thanks for applying!

If you have any issues or concerns, feel free to contact myself, or any of the Senior staff members.
